items.q: Do I need a technical team to use Nodo?
items.a: No. You describe the process in plain language and we handle analysis, build and documentation.

items.q: How long does an automation take?
items.a: The automatic quote includes an estimated time. Most processes ship in days, not months.

items.q: Does it work with the tools I already use?
items.a: Yes. We build on your current tools whenever they expose integrations or an API.
